Name: Fishing Don't Stop Time
Author: LyzzCL
Description:
[size=3]This is a very basic mod that will make time keep running while reeling in a fish.[/size]

[size=3]I made this just for my personal use since I use some expansion mods and I have to use [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/169]TimeSpeed[/url][size=3] to make time go slow, so while I'm fishing time goes extremely slow due to time freezing. This just makes so game time updates while fishing, there shouldn't be a problem with other mods that affect time. [/size]

[size=3]This is obviously intended for single player since multiplayer does this by default.[/size]

[size=3]Use [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]GMCM[/url][size=3] to select if you want to freeze villagers or enemies while fishing. Useful in case you are struggling fishing for example on Ridgeside Village forest with tons of enemies around :P[/size]
